newsitem.title: ITALY: Autostrade share conversion not yet set.
newsitem.headline: Autostrade share conversion not yet set.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said the government had not yet decided if preference shares in soon to be privatised motorway operator Autostrade would be converted into ordinary shares even though he said there is "a tendency in this direction."
Addressing the upper house Senate's public works commission, he confirmed that the government hoped to complete Autostrade's privatisation "by the end of June or beginning of July."
Ciampi said the government was studying "the conditions for the sale, the question of a stable shareholding and criteria which would avoid conflicts of interest.
"We haven't yet defined the criteria but these would be aimed at excluding construction companies and groups which have specific interests," he added.
"We are thinking of establishing stake holding limits for Autostrade. There is already a five percent limit but we need to see if this should be reduced," Ciampi added.
